product_block:
WHAT INTERVIEW SARTHI DOES
- Listens during your online interview and shows suggested answers on your own screen.
- Answers are built from your resume and your projects, so they sound like you, not like a template.
- Replies in the language the interviewer used: English, Hindi or Hinglish, even when they switch mid-question.
- Runs beside Microsoft Teams, Zoom and Google Meet on a Windows laptop.
- The overlay is hidden from supported screen sharing while staying visible to you. Capture support varies.
- Ask box: type any question about the meeting and get an answer from the live transcript.

WHAT IT COSTS
- 30 minutes free with every feature. No card, no signup.
- 2-Day Pass Rs 99. 7-Day Pass Rs 399. 1-Month Pass Rs 999. 3-Month Pass Rs 1,999.
- Every pass is one-time. Nothing renews and nothing auto-charges.
- It runs on your own free Gemini key, so the AI itself costs you Rs 0.

REQUIREMENTS
- Windows 10 (version 2004 or newer) or Windows 11. Your own Gemini API key.
- Illustrative demonstrations use a fictional resume and edited timing.
engagement_questions: Which round worries you more, HR or technical?
Which company is your next interview with?
English or Hinglish: what did your last interviewer use?
Which question do you always blank on?
First interview or one of many? Tell us below.
Would you want this answer ready before your call? Say yes or no.

voices._comment: Human voices in order, then Edge as the last resort. Chirp 3 HD first: same Achird voice, about 1s per line, no 10-a-day quota (billed to the Veo project, first 1M chars/month free). Gemini second: takes a style direction but its free tier allows 10 calls a day and a reel needs 4. Set engine to 'edge' to disable both. gemini_voice/chirp_voice: Achird (friendly), Sadaltager, Charon, Sulafat (female).

_hashtags_note: Instagram allows 5 hashtags per post since December 2025 and Mosseri has confirmed they do not drive reach; they only tell the algorithm what a post is about. So we use few and specific. The pool above is a guide to the register we want, not a list to copy: tags a particular Indian fresher would search, naming the exam, the company or the round. Broad tags such as #CareerAdvice put us in a global pool we cannot win and teach the algorithm nothing.
